items.title: TSCA health and safety data reporting — comment extension (EPA)
items.abstract: EPA extended the reporting deadline for certain chemical health and safety data under TSCA. Public comments were open on the Federal Register notice; use the official docket for the current status.
items.why_it_matters: Chemical reporting rules shape what communities and workers know about toxics — comment periods are a direct way to weigh in.
